chunks: And it is narrated: that al-Sadiq عليه السلام mentioned the Dajjal and said:

"No plain land of it shall remain except that he will tread upon it, except Makkah and al-Madinah, for upon every mountain pass of the two of them is an angel protecting them from plague and the Dajjal."

key_terms.الدَّجَّالَ: the false messianic deceiver associated with the end times
key_terms.الصَّادِقَ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker mentioned in the report
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةَ: al-Madinah, the sacred city protected from the Dajjal
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred sanctuary protected from the Dajjal
key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angel appointed as a protector

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the Dajjal entering Makkah and Madinah?
ai.summary: This narration describes a sign related to the Dajjal, stating that his reach will extend broadly across the land except for Makkah and al-Madinah. It highlights the protected sanctity of these two sacred cities, where angels guard their entrances from plague and from the Dajjal.
